# Transactions: Send a Transaction to Taxbit

Area overview and notes: [transactions.md](../transactions.md)

`POST /transactions/external-id` · tenant-scoped token

Send (create or update) transactions to Taxbit using your system's unique identifier for the Transaction.

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | Yes | External transaction type for submission. One of: `adjustment`, `cost-basis-transfer`, `deposit`, `expense`, `income`, `stake`, `trade`, `unstake`, `withdraw`, `contribution`, `distribution`. |
| `id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Transaction. |
| `taxbit_id` | string (uuid) | No | Taxbit's internal identifier for the Transaction. |
| `account_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |
| `taxbit_account_id` | string (uuid) | No | ID of the Account. This is the Taxbit ID. |
| `tenant_id` | string | No | ID of the Tenant. |
| `datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the transaction occurred. |
| `subtype` | string | No | Transaction subtype. Valid subtypes by transaction type: - **deposit**: ach, blockchain, card-reward, gift, cost-basis-fmv, internal-personal - **withdraw**: ach, blockchain, gift, internal-personal - **income**: royalties, rent, gross-proceeds-paid-to-an-attorney, nec, payment-goods, payment-services, other, airdrop, reward, staking-reward, medical-payment, referral-bonus, interest-fiat-backed, interest-crypto-backed, fee-refund - **expense**: debit, fee, refund - **cost-basis-transfer**: wrapping, asset-name-change - **contribution**: standard, postponed, recharacterization, conversion, rollover, late-rollover. One of 42 values: see [values/subtype.md](../values/subtype.md). |
| `disposition_method` | string | No | If present, this disposition method overrides the default disposition method for only this transaction. Supported disposition methods are HIFO, FIFO, LIFO, LOFO, and SPECID. One of: `HIFO`, `FIFO`, `LIFO`, `LOFO`, `SPECID`. |
| `counterparty_transaction_id` | string | No | Your system's unique identifier for the counterparty Transaction. |
| `parent_id` | string | No | Your system's unique identifier for the Transaction being adjusted. This field is required when type is 'adjustment'. |
| `platform` | object | No |  |

| `platform.name` | string | No | Platform Name. |

| `sent[].inventory_lots` | object | No | A collection of specific lots to dispose when applying the transaction to inventory. Object keyed by Taxbit lot IDs (retrieved via the GET /inventory endpoint) that map to quantity values. Required when disposition_method is 'SPECID'.
